noncomputable def VTask.leastOfBdd {P : ℤ → Prop} [DecidablePred P] (b : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → b ≤ z) (Hinh : ∃ z, P z) : { lb // P lb ∧ ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → lb ≤ z } :=
let ⟨lb, hlb⟩ := Hinh in
let rec findLeast (z : ℤ) : ℤ × (P z → z ≤ lb) :=
  if Hb z hlb then (z, fun h => h)
  else findLeast (z + 1) in
let (lb', hlble) := findLeast b in
have hlble' : ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → lb' ≤ z := fun z h => hlble h
show { lb' // P lb' ∧ ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → lb' ≤ z } from
  ⟨lb', by simp [hlble'], by intros z h; apply hlble'⟩
